label: Nhóm 22 - Smart Grocery 10 Shelves
info:
## Smart shelf: ten rack prototype

ESP32 telemetry contains readings for K01-K10 when sensors are connected. Wokwi values are simulator data. Node-RED transaction simulation is manual and does not run on a timer.

MQTT default: broker.hivemq.com. Telegram reads TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_IDS from environment variables.

name: 📡 TẦNG 1: THU NHẬN DỮ LIỆU MQTT
ESP32 gửi JSON mỗi 2.5s qua topic nhom22/smartshelf/telemetry
info: Dữ liệu JSON gồm: device, uptime, shelves[] (id, name, weight, unit, qty, min, low_stock), total_alerts

🎛️ TẦNG 5: ĐIỀU KHIỂN DOWNLINK (Tare / Set / Status)
Gửi lệnh JSON qua MQTT topic nhom22/smartshelf/cmd → ESP32 thực thi
info:
Lệnh hỗ trợ:
- {"cmd":"tare","id":"K1"} → Hiệu chuẩn 0g
- {"cmd":"set","id":"K1","name":"Pepsi","unit":330,"min":2} → Cài đặt kệ
- {"cmd":"status"} → Yêu cầu gửi telemetry ngay
